name: use-mfa
title: useMfa, useStepUp
description: useMfa and useStepUp: the mfa block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the mfa block (`npx better-supabase add mfa`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/auth/mfa-sso.
